articles.title: Connecticut's new lawsuit against Kalshi piles on to prediction market legal fight
articles.snippet: The courtroom combat across state and federal courts is so far producing roughly split outcomes, suggesting a big job may be coming for the Supreme Court.

articles.title: Ethena surges as buyback vote, VC unlock overhaul boost token outlook
articles.snippet: The changes aim to cut investor selling pressure and channel protocol revenue to ENA as Ethena looks to revive USDe growth.

articles.title: GTA 6 leaker cashes out of his own memecoin hours before Rockstar's gameplay reveal
articles.snippet: The token hit a $25 million market cap on the back of nine days of unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI footage. Its creator has now sold his stack — hours before Rockstar's first official gameplay reveal.

articles.title: Polish Olympic chief arrested as prosecutors probe suspected crypto-linked bribe
articles.snippet: Prosecutors are probing allegations that Zondacrypto's CEO gave Radosław Piesiewicz a 40,000 euro watch for help with regulatory hurdles.

articles.title: 240 UK taxpayers made more than $1.3 million each from crypto holdings in fiscal 2025
articles.snippet: For the first time, the U.K.'s tax office broke out crypto capital gains figures, showing 17,600 people reported $1.87 billion in profits during the 2024-2025 tax year.
